input_text: I started running in the mornings a few months ago. At first I could barely finish a kilometer. My legs would ache and my breathing was ragged. But I kept showing up. Each week got a little easier. Now I run three kilometers most mornings and it has become the best part of my day. The quiet streets, the dawn light, the rhythm of my footsteps. Running taught me that consistency matters more than intensity. I learned to appreciate small progress instead of demanding instant results.
